Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm caramel complexion, late 20s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, long straight platinum silver hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a cropped halter-neck top of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey tied behind her neck with a navy satin ribbon and a small gold crest patch on the left of her chest, her shoulders, arms and upper back bare, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro pleated skirt of ultra-thin matte deep teal modal jersey with a thin gold stripe along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones with a plain ultra-high slit up the right side from the hem to her hip bone, with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the crisp pleats of the skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.

Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart shapes painted on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips.

Background: the Dubai waterfront promenade at golden hour with the glittering skyline of skyscrapers behind; her giant stiletto heel stands in the foreground like a monument, with hundreds of tiny visitors in white kanduras, abayas and summer clothes taking photos, tiny cars and tiny tour buses gathered in a crowd around the base of the heel, every person at their true real size and only as tall as the heel is long, all looking up at it; she is a colossal giant, her towering heels planted on the stone promenade, her body rising high above the crowd and the buildings, a glowing golden-orange sunset sky behind her, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm golden sunset light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from ground level with the camera low among the crowd and tilted upward, her giant stiletto shoe and its slender heel large in the foreground at the bottom of the frame, the whole figure from the heel tips up to the top of her head completely visible rising far above the crowd, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
